thread.title: Participation Section A: Llama (Meta AI) on HW0
thread.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>I interacted with Llama/Meta AI and had a rather disappointing result. For the (easier) questions it answered, it made decent progress on showing the math steps but was vague at times and couldn't tell left multiplication from right. It had trouble answering questions one-by-one like a student would, instead fixating on the topic of the question and ranting about it.</paragraph><file url="https://static.us.edusercontent.com/files/NL3zdbbcBsPHnQ8BtKrczKa1" filename="CS182 Special Participation A_ Llama.pdf"/><paragraph/></document>
